name: Pi Review - Minimal, extensible terminal coding agent with skills, tree-structured sessions, multi-provider support, and explicit sandboxing guidance.
description: Pi is a terminal-first coding agent that takes the opposite approach from feature-bloated harnesses: keep the core minimal, then let developers shape the workflow with extensions, skills, prompt templates, themes, and packages.
